title: filenode-server: emit sha256:null for dirs when jmap:cid advertised
description: draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 L206-213: when jmap:cid and FileNode are both advertised, FileNode objects "MUST include" sha256, which "MUST be null for directory FileNodes". FileNode.sha256 is Option<Sha256> (JMAP-01ba.1) and is omitted when None, so the types crate cannot tell absent from null. The server must insert "sha256": null into /get output for Directory/SymLink (and legacy-file) nodes when jmap:cid is advertised. Surfaced by JMAP-01ba.1.
